f.title: Pet travel forum: real trips with dogs and cats
f.lead: Real trips with dogs and cats by plane, train, bus, subway, taxi, car and ferry. Anyone can read; sign in to share your own experience.

f.soon.p: We're preparing a moderated forum where pet owners share real trips with dogs and cats: planes, trains, buses, taxis, cars and ferries. It will open here soon.
f.soon.p2: In the meantime, compare airline pet policies or browse carrier guides.
adm.only: This page is for forum moderators. Sign in with an admin account.
f.disclaimer: Experiences are shared by travellers and checked by a moderator before they appear. They are personal accounts, not airline rules: always confirm with the airline or operator.
